scripts.build:plugin: bun build bridge/src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=plugin/daemon/webmcp-daemon.js && bun build bridge/src/mcp-relay.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=plugin/daemon/webmcp-mcp.js && bun build node_modules/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/dist/index.js --target=node --format=esm --outfile=plugin/daemon/claude-agent-acp.js
scripts.check:bundles: bun run build:plugin >/dev/null && git diff --quiet -- plugin/daemon/webmcp-daemon.js plugin/daemon/claude-agent-acp.js || (echo 'plugin/daemon bundles are stale: run bun run build:plugin and commit' && exit 1)
